title: Vault - Security Overview
description:
Security overview of HashiCorp Vault audit logs: secret access, root token use, privilege and configuration changes, authentication and access denials, and Cloud SIEM signals.

- [Vault integration documentation](https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/vault/)
- [Vault audit devices](https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/docs/audit)

definition.content:
Use this dashboard to monitor HashiCorp Vault audit logs, including:

- Who reads, deletes, and exports secrets
- Root token use
- Changes to policies, identity groups, and configuration
- How identities authenticate and when they are denied access

Audit logs come from a Vault [audit device](https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/docs/audit) and are collected with `source:vault`. Vault writes a request entry and a response entry for every call. This dashboard counts only responses.

KV secret reads leave out KV v2 metadata, configuration, and subkeys requests. Audit logs don't record the KV version, so a KV v1 secret at a path ending in metadata, config, or subkeys can be left out too if it has a field named current_version, max_versions, or subkeys.

For further reading, see:

- [Vault integration documentation](https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/vault/)

- [Vault audit devices](https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/docs/audit)

- [Datadog Cloud SIEM](https://docs.datadoghq.com/security/cloud_siem/)

definition.title: Requests by secrets engine and auth method
Most used engines and auth methods

definition.content: Datadog Cloud SIEM analyzes and correlates Vault logs to detect threats to your environment in real time. If you don't see signals, make sure you've enabled and configured [Datadog Cloud SIEM](/security/siem).

query.query_string: source:vault @type:response ((@request.mount_type:kv @request.operation:read -(@http.url_details.path:(*\/metadata OR *\/metadata\/* OR *\/config OR *\/subkeys\/*) ((@response.data.current_version:* OR @response.data.max_versions:* OR @response.data.subkeys:*) OR ((-@response.mount_type:* OR @response.status:error) -(@http.url_details.path:(*\/data\/*metadata OR *\/data\/*metadata\/* OR *\/data\/*config OR *\/data\/*subkeys\/*) -@http.url_details.path:(*\/metadata\/data\/* OR *\/metadata\/*\/data\/* OR *\/subkeys\/data\/* OR *\/subkeys\/*\/data\/*)))))) OR (@request.mount_type:kv (@request.operation:delete OR (@http.url_details.path:(*\/destroy\/* OR *\/delete\/*) @request.operation:(create OR update) @request.data.versions:*)))) $user $client_ip $mount_type $operation $path
